audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side is a blanket 'Skill' on every row while content win[0..6] and every whys/spikes/early/mid/late string say Zyra wins the entire matchup. The packet itself flags this: 'level chart contradicts data: Tahm Kench wins 56.7% but the chart gives Zyra 7/7 stages vs 0'.
audit.why: As with the Xerath matchup, the packet's defect note is about the overall win-rate stat vs. the per-stage chart, not evidence the chart is wrong — Tahm Kench's 56.7% is a full-game stat, while content's per-stage prose (seeded Q/plant poke, E root into burst, R knock-up punishing dives, late zone control) consistently and specifically supports Zyra winning every laning stage before TK's tank kit closes the gap post-lane. The full layer's blanket 'Skill' is the generic even-matchup template, contradicted by its own diffRating (7/10 Tricky) and carryRating (7.5/10) on the same page.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0..6].side to Zyra to match win[0..6] (already Zyra, so no content edit needed per the chart rule) and rewrote each phases[N].why to state the specific Zyra interaction from the kit (seeded Q/plant poke, E root into burst, plant stacking, R knock-up, Liandry's scaling, late zone/objective control) instead of the generic Skill-chart filler.

audit.why: Content spikes correctly key to level 2 (root-plus-plant burst), level 6 (R knock-up punishes the dive), first item (Liandry's plant DPS), and late (zone/R control at objectives).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[9].t and report[11].t misgender Zyra as 'his' (lint MISGENDER — Zyra is she/her per champ-gender.js); breakdown.cooldowns has no digit despite Grasping Roots having a real cooldown.
audit.why: dosFull[1].t promises advice about devouring the all-in's focus and dontsFull[2].t promises advice about Q-ing chip instead of diving, but neither body matches its own title; four separate fields referred to Zyra as male.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to match their titles, fixed all four misgender instances to 'her', and added Grasping Roots' 11s cooldown plus R's 110/100/90s to breakdown.cooldowns.
